description: Use this when a PostgreSQL rule can break with two users at once, after a migration or transaction change. Runs the local VibeRaven race preview on real PostgreSQL 18.6 through @viberaven/sessions, without Docker. Use example:true for the bundled test, or a reviewed viberaven.race.json in the app. Returns bounded statement orders, the first broken order and report paths. Fix, rerun, then use from and replay to replay exactly what broke. Requires Node 24+ with JSPI and an already installed matching CLI with the sessions runtime. Writes local .viberaven artifacts and executes trusted repository SQL only; no hosted database access. An incomplete result is not a pass.

cwd.description: Local app root. Defaults to the MCP server cwd.

example.description: Run the bundled two-user example without changing app migrations.

from.description: Complete original report path, required with replay. Use the exact path returned by race.

replay.description: Zero-based broken record index returned as firstBroken, required with from.

spec.description: Reviewed local JSON spec path; defaults to viberaven.race.json.

name: viberaven_race
